item.title: Eritrea walks away from East African bloc
item.description: Eritrea has announced its withdrawal from the East African regional bloc Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD), accusing it of abandoning neutrality and acting against member states like itself. item.title: Can AI learn Africa’s languages?
item.description: A major challenge is emerging as AI advances: most of Africa’s estimated 1,500 to 3,000 languages are being left behind because of insufficient digital data. While English has millions of online resources, many African languages have few or none, making it impossible to use them for training standard large language models.
